lede: The biggest thing on the government calendar this week is San Miguel County's Planning Commission taking up proposed amendments to the Affordable Housing Impact Mitigation Fee — a fee structure that directly shapes whether workforce housing gets built here or stays on paper. Alongside that, the Open Space Commission digs into the Valley Floor goat grazing pilot, pressing for real data on costs and vegetation outcomes, and Ouray's Planning Commission weighs a proposed ordinance on natural medicine regulation. On the lighter side, the week fills out with the KOTO Ski Swap, the Ridgway Independent Film Festival, and a Long Table Dinner at Wilkinson Monday night.
